run_main: run a Python file as __main__ with patched sys.argv and sys.path
run_main_subproc: run a Python file in a spawned subprocess to avoid OpenGL context clashes
powerset: generate all combinations of an iterable including the empty set
test_example_modules: test Habitat Lab tutorial example modules by running them in a subprocess
test_rearrange_example_modules: test Habitat 2 rearrange example modules including interactive play and gym tutorials
